deployments_detail.use: SOMPO AI Agent: enterprise AI assistant rolled out to ~30,000 employees across domestic group companies for internal document search and summarization, desktop research, meeting minutes, and data analysis. Piloted on Google Cloud's Gemini Enterprise while also evaluating Microsoft Copilot Studio. [Google Cloud (Gemini Enterprise); Microsoft (Copilot Studio, evaluation)]

Proprietary optimized conversational generative AI chat system deployed group-wide, used for tasks such as meeting-minute creation and email drafting, with employee training programs. [Sompo (in-house / proprietary)]
deployments_detail.value: used by over 50% of employees in first phase

deployments_detail.use: AI agent 'Heylix' used to automate extraction/transcription of information from clients' fixed asset ledgers for corporate fire insurance assessments, eliminating manual pre-processing. [AI inside Inc. (Heylix)]

EIS ClaimGuard AI fraud-detection solution selected to identify fraudulent auto insurance claim patterns and accelerate legitimate claims, supporting a new fraud-focused department. [EIS Group (ClaimGuard)]
"SOMPO AI Agent" (Google Gemini Enterprise) to ~30,000 domestic group employees (Jan 2026, claimed largest single-group deployment in Japan); "Ask SOMPO" knowledge search
AI Estimate Check: AI validates the legitimacy of auto repairs and repair costs from images and estimates, so claims staff only examine flagged cases. Uses Tractable's image AI. [Tractable Ltd.]
deployments_detail.value: ~50,000 cases checked monthly (May 2023); target 40% of ~1M annual cases by 2025

deployments_detail.use: Palantir Foundry + AIP used across underwriting, pricing and risk management; operational in Brazil marine insurance to interpret physical documents and propose pricing based on historical context and risk factors. [Palantir Technologies (Foundry, AIP)]

Real Data Platform for nursing care (Sompo Care), powered by Palantir Foundry, giving shift workers a secure environment to view and manage tenant care data including tailored sensor data across care facilities in Japan since 2020. [Palantir Technologies (Foundry)]
AI-based automated underwriting platform combining GeoX geospatial/property data with Sompo modeling to assess natural-disaster risk for property underwriting. [GeoX]
Long-term agreement to migrate Sompo globally to Guidewire Cloud Platform and adopt Guidewire's AI-powered applications to operationalize GenAI at scale across core insurance operations. [Guidewire]
SOMPO Okuruma Smart Evaluation: industry-first service using AI image analysis of smartphone photos to determine whether a vehicle is a total loss, enabling same-day claim payouts. [Sompo Japan]
AI used in Sompo Care facilities to personalize resident care by analyzing sleep data and care records. [Sompo Care]
Insurance digital transformation and AI-enhanced underwriting using Foundry + AIP (multi-year data integration and AI investment) [Palantir] [Palantir]

Conversational AI in Sompo Japan claims call centers (COTOHA Voice DX Premium) to receive insurance-claim notifications during large-scale disasters, handling up to 3,000 calls per hour. [NTT Communications (COTOHA Voice DX Premium)]
